selection: All original 20 crop rows and all selected 12 full-page rows; no results-based removal.

old20.source: Original frozen V13 resized RGBA before channel adaptation; CTC observed in V14 enhancedRRR/BGR with identical original cohort contexts.
old20.pixelMeaning: Original frozen raw resized RGBA; enhancedRRR is the recorded recognizer channel mode, not a claim that PNG pixels were enhanced.

new12.source: Same-flow native Canvas zero-model reconstruction; not original historical RGBA.

ctc: Only original argmax index/max/blank/space sufficient statistics. Unobserved class values are not captured; dense surrogate is not the original complete logits.
ledger: Each complete observed cohort is a selected-window replay scope with a locally renumbered original read order; 42 other full-page RGBA reads are missing. No exact historical whole-page optional ledger claim. Shared budget across runs is separately exercised as a synthetic protocol test.
truth: Independent frozen text is separate from original SDK text and reference controller output; 3 noise rows remain unscored.
runtime: All fixture files are relative and self-contained; no model/font/SDK/private runtime/external repository or evidence directory needed.
